i18n.switcher.ariaLabel.description: Screen-reader label of the language menu button. {language} is the current language by its own name, e.g. "English".

i18n.switcher.label.description: Tooltip of the language menu button in the top navigation. The button itself shows the current language by its own name (English, Français (Canada)).

pricing.layout.cannotSaveInvalidPrices.defaultMessage: Cannot save: {count, plural, one {# price is} other {# prices are}} not valid. Correct the prices listed under Invalid prices and save again.
pricing.layout.cannotSaveInvalidPrices.description: Error shown when Save changes is chosen on the Pricing page while some prices are invalid. {count} is how many.

pricing.layout.invalidPrice.defaultMessage: Enter a non-negative decimal number with no spaces, such as 0.0015 or 6.0E-8.
pricing.layout.invalidPrice.description: Inline error under a price field on the Pricing page when the value is not a valid price.

pricing.layout.invalidPriceItem.defaultMessage: {apiName} / {unitName}: "{price}" is not a valid price. Use a non-negative decimal number with no spaces, such as 0.0015 or 6.0E-8.
pricing.layout.invalidPriceItem.description: One line in the list of invalid prices on the Pricing page. {apiName} is the service/API name, {unitName} the unit name, {price} the value as typed.

pricing.layout.invalidPricesHeader.description: Header of the warning that lists every price on the Pricing page that cannot be saved.

testStudio.itemEdit.regroupPending.description: Why Edit Page Grouping is unavailable: a page grouping was just saved and the document editor is still re-reading the saved sections.

testStudio.itemEdit.regroupRereadFailed.defaultMessage: The saved grouping could not be re-read. Choose Refresh to load it.
testStudio.itemEdit.regroupRereadFailed.description: Why Edit Page Grouping is unavailable: re-reading the sections after a page grouping was saved failed. Refresh is a button on the same page.
